item.title: The City of Charleston Office of Cultural Affairs Announces "The Message is Clear: A Mentored Photography Exhibition" at City Gallery
item.description: The City of Charleston Office of Cultural Affairs presents "The Message is Clear: A Mentored Photography Exhibition," on view at City Gallery from Feb. 20 through May 3, 2026.

item.title: Victor’s Seafood & Steak to host Second Annual “Oak & Smoke” on Hutson Alley
item.description: Following the success of last year’s inaugural event, Victor’s Seafood & Steak will host the second Oak & Smoke on March 19 from 6 p.m. to 10 p.m. on Hutson Alley in downtown Charleston.

item.title: KJ Atwood for Congress Launches Fellowship Program and Expands Volunteer Opportunities
item.description: KJ Atwood for Congress announced today the launch of its Fellowship Program, a hands-on opportunity for college students, non-traditional students, and young adults across South Carolina to gain real experience

item.title: The Halsey Institute of Contemporary Art Announces "Art as a Conduit to the Spiritual"
item.description: Art lovers, museum goers, and those with an interest in the divine, join us for a lecture entitled Art as a "Conduit to the Spiritual," by Amanda Sroka, Senior Curator at the Institute of Contemporary Art, Los Angeles.

item.title: Sunrise Yoga program series: Morning Yoga in a beautiful park setting
item.description: Charleston County Parks’ Sunrise Yoga program is back at select park sites this spring and summer. The first Sunrise Yoga class in the series will be held Saturday, April 11 at Caw Caw Interpretive Center starting at 6:30 a.m.

item.title: Local Voices Urge Legislators for Action on Energy Affordability
item.description: On Feb. 18, South Carolinians from across the state gathered at the Statehouse to share their experiences with rising energy costs and urge their legislators to act.

item.title: Carolina Children’s Charity Hosts March 22 Oyster Roast
item.description: Carolina Children’s Charity will partner with Bohemian Bull for its annual Oyster Roast on Sunday, March 22, from 2 to 6 p.m.

item.title: Patriots Point and Town of Mount Pleasant Host Black History Month Presentation
item.description: Patriots Point Naval & Maritime Museum, in partnership with the Town of Mount Pleasant, will host a special Black History Month presentation on Saturday, February 28, 2026, aboard the historic USS Yorktown.

item.title: CBPR to Host Fundraiser for New Morning at Harbour Club
item.description: Local marketing firm CBPR invites the community to an evening on the Terrace at the Harbour Club at WestEdge on Thursday, March 19, from 5:30 to 7 p.m., benefiting South Carolina nonprofit New Morning
